title: The derived open-extension unit is invertible
statement: For every coefficient datum R and open immersion j, the unit of PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction R j is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 03DI, derived extension by zero on a pro-etale slice.

proof.text: Identify openExtension with localized module extension on a pro-etale slice using the slice presentation. The localized extension has invertible unit by subterminality, so it is fully faithful. Transport full faithfulness across the presentation and apply unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful to openDerivedAdjunction.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03DI and the slice-presentation argument in openProjectionInverse_isIso.

lean.statement:
theorem openDerivedAdjunction_unit_isIso
    (R : Coefficients.{u}) {U V : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    IsIso (openDerivedAdjunction R j).unit
